sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Kalim,Mary Puncha (Sheeb Jose)
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Mohd. Kalim, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Suresh Bahadur Singh, learned AGA for the State.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
455 of 2022, under Sections 380, 411, 420 IPC, Police Station Rorawar, District Aligarh during pendency of the trial.

FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and according to the FIR version some unknown persons anyhow changed the ATM card of the informant and thereafter from his account Rs. 35,000/- was withdrawn.
It is further alleged in the FIR that through CCTV footage it revealed to the informant that applicant was the person, who withdrew the money from the account of the informant.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and on the basis of CCTV footage applicant was made accused in the present matter and merely on the basis of CCTV footage it cannot be said that applicant is the person who was withdrawing the money by using the ATM card of the informant as it is nowhere Muneesh @ Monu @ Lala vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77685505/
1 stated either in the FIR or in the statement that through CCTV footage it was revealed that applicant was the person who changed the ATM of the informant by playing fraud and it appears that applicant was known to the informant, therefore, if he is the person who changed the ATM then informant must mention this fact in the FIR.

sentences.text: He next submits that when applicant was arrested then it is alleged that from his possession Rs. 36,500/- and 22 ATM cards were recovered but as far as recovery of money is concerned, the recovered money belongs to the applicant and no ATM card was recovered and applicant was not named in the FIR and when he was arrested by the police then false recovery of 22 ATM Cards were shown against the applicant.

Applicant was not having any previous criminal history but when he was arrested in the present matter then he simultaneously made accused in as many as six other cases and entire criminal history of the applicant has been explained in paragraph-13 to the affidavit and applicant in the present matter is in jail since 15.10.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant was identified through CCTV footage therefore, it cannot be said that he was falsely implicated in the present matter but he could not dispute the fact that neither in the FIR nor in the statement informant disclosed that applicant is the person who changed his ATM card although he knew the applicant.
He further could not dispute the fact that no timing of withdrawal of the money by the applicant has been mentioned in the entire case diary and applicant was not having any previous criminal history.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
Although, applicant is named in the FIR on the basis of CCTV footage and as per FIR from the perusal of the CCTV footage applicant was the person who withdrawing the money but merely on the basis of CCTV footage it cannot be said that applicant was using the ATM of the informant as there is no evidence that he is the person who changed the ATM card of the informant and informant also known to him, therefore, if he changed the ATM then this fact must be disclosed by the informant either in the FIR or in the statement but no such fact has been narrated by him either in the FIR or in the statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.

Further, even during investigation no such evidence could be collected by the Investigating Officer on the basis of which it could be presumed that from the ATM applicant withdrew the amount of the informant by using his ATM card and even in the entire case diary the time of use of ATM by the applicant has not been narrated and applicant in the present matter is in jail since 15.10.2022.
Therefore, from the discussion made above, in view of this Court, it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant - Muneesh @ Monu @ Lala be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
